symptom_observation: Riparo anteriore integro; nessun gioco anomalo sulla guida.
diagnosis: Controllo giornaliero conforme, no safety issue detected.
action_taken: Pulita la guida, verificata la chiusura e registrato il test dell'interblocco.
verification_test: Tre aperture durante ciclo manuale: movimento inibito ogni volta.

symptom_observation: Lubrication film thin on rear toggle pins; tiranti puliti e senza rigature.
diagnosis: Normal grease depletion at scheduled interval.
action_taken: Puliti i punti di ingrassaggio e applicato grasso EP2 secondo la scheda interna.
verification_test: Five dry clamp cycles, no stick-slip and no abnormal noise.
follow_up_notes: Check grease consumption trend at next 250 h service.

symptom_observation: Zone 2 temperature dropped to 161 C while setpoint remained 205 C.
diagnosis: Heater band open circuit; resistenza elettrica fuori campo.
action_taken: Messa in sicurezza, sostituita fascia riscaldante e serrati i terminali; warm-up eseguito.
verification_test: Temperature stable within +/-2 C for 30 minutes and 20 production cycles.
follow_up_notes: Thermal camera check recommended at quarterly inspection.

symptom_observation: Polvere di granulo visibile su tramoggia e griglia magnetica.
diagnosis: Accumulo normale da cambio materiale; nessuna contaminazione metallica.
action_taken: Aspirata la tramoggia, pulita la gola di alimentazione e controllata la griglia magnetica.
verification_test: Material feed test completed; no bridging for 50 cycles.
follow_up_notes: Keep hopper lid closed during production.

symptom_observation: Portata circuito stampo ridotta; return water warmer than usual.
diagnosis: Filtro parzialmente ostruito da deposito calcareo.
action_taken: Isolato il circuito, pulito il filtro e risciacquate le linee con soluzione approvata.
verification_test: No leaks; supply/return delta stabilized at 3.2 C.
follow_up_notes: Monitor water hardness; target below internal limit.

symptom_observation: Safety channel B flickered when rear gate was fully closed.
diagnosis: Attuatore interblocco disallineato e connettore con ritenuta danneggiata.
action_taken: LOTO applicato; riallineato supporto, sostituito connettore e verificati entrambi i canali safety.
verification_test: 20 open/close repetitions plus emergency stop validation: all passed.
follow_up_notes: Safety function released by authorized maintainer.

symptom_observation: Oil level normal; sample slightly darker than previous quarter.
diagnosis: Particle count acceptable but trending upward.
action_taken: Sampled oil, replaced breather element and topped up with compatible hydraulic fluid.
verification_test: Pump pressure stable and no foaming after 15-minute run.
follow_up_notes: Repeat oil sample; investigate if cleanliness worsens by one code.

symptom_observation: Piccolo deposito carbonizzato sul foro ugello after black-to-natural change.
diagnosis: Residuo materiale, nessun danno alla punta.
action_taken: Eseguito purge controllato, smontata e pulita la punta ugello, verificato il centraggio.
verification_test: Ten purge shots clean; nozzle contact test passed.

symptom_observation: Peak injection pressure differed from reference sensor; scostamento 6.8% FS.
diagnosis: Zero drift del trasduttore, cablaggio e connettori conformi.
action_taken: Calibrato zero/span con riferimento certificato e aggiornato il record di taratura.
verification_test: Three-point check at 50, 100 and 150 bar equivalent: passed.
follow_up_notes: Calibration certificate CAL-B35E-260418 stored in CMMS.

symptom_observation: Nessuna anomalia visiva sui pulsanti di arresto.
diagnosis: Circuito disponibile per prova funzionale periodica.
action_taken: Testati arresto frontale, posteriore e reset controllato; registrati tempi di arresto.
verification_test: All motion and hydraulic enable removed; reset did not restart cycle.

symptom_observation: Film d'olio sul raccordo pressato H3; no active spray.
diagnosis: Crimp sleeve seepage confirmed under clamp pressure.
action_taken: Depressurizzato il circuito, sostituito tubo H3, pulita area e serrati i raccordi a coppia.
verification_test: Leak test at operating pressure for 20 minutes; 30 clamp cycles passed.
follow_up_notes: Visual recheck after one production week.

symptom_observation: Ejector return smooth but guide surfaces were dry.
diagnosis: Lubrificazione programmata necessaria, nessuna usura visibile.
action_taken: Pulite guide e finecorsa, applicato velo di grasso compatibile e verificato il ritorno.
verification_test: 25 ejector strokes at low and normal speed: passed.
follow_up_notes: Trend motor current at next service.

symptom_observation: Zona 3 oscillava di 19.4 C e il trend showed short dropouts.
diagnosis: Thermocouple junction intermittent near cable strain relief.
action_taken: Sostituita termocoppia, fissato cavo lontano dalle superfici calde e verificata la polarità.
verification_test: Stable at setpoint for 40 minutes and 30 molded parts accepted.
follow_up_notes: Inspect cable routing during next heater check.

symptom_observation: Cushion variation increased to 3.8 mm over 20 shots.
diagnosis: Check ring contaminated by degraded material; wear within service limit.
action_taken: Eseguito purge ad alta viscosità e ciclo di pulizia vite; ricontrollata la ripetibilità.
verification_test: 30-shot study: cushion and part weight within internal tolerance.
follow_up_notes: Plan mechanical inspection if cushion range exceeds 2.5 mm.

symptom_observation: Thermal scan showed 76.2 C on K1 line terminal, altri terminali sotto 45 C.
diagnosis: Contact resistance elevated; terminal discoloration confirmed.
action_taken: Isolata alimentazione, sostituito contattore K1, rifatti capicorda e serraggio controllato.
verification_test: Full-load run 45 minutes; phase currents balanced and no hotspot.
follow_up_notes: Repeat thermography after four production weeks.

symptom_observation: Temperatura olio raggiungeva 68.4 C durante sequenza lunga.
diagnosis: Alette lato aria sporche e flusso ridotto; ventola funzionante.
action_taken: Pulito scambiatore, verificato senso ventola e liberato il passaggio aria.
verification_test: One-hour production run; temperature stable below 57 C.
follow_up_notes: Keep cabinet and exchanger intake unobstructed.

symptom_observation: Clamp force reading slightly below target after cambio stampo.
diagnosis: Setup offset, no hydraulic or mechanical defect found.
action_taken: Ricalibrato zero posizione, regolato setpoint e verificata la parallelità del piano mobile.
verification_test: Low-pressure mold protection and ten clamp cycles passed.
follow_up_notes: Verify again at next mold change.

symptom_observation: Backup battery warning active at startup; measured voltage 2.6 V.
diagnosis: Batteria a fine vita, controller memory still retained.
action_taken: Eseguito backup parametri, sostituita batteria con alimentazione controllata e verificato restore.
verification_test: Cold restart, recipe recall and alarm history retention all passed.
follow_up_notes: Battery replacement interval set to 24 months.
